description: Plugin assignments for sync-to-plugin.sh. Maps each item in the extracted prompts/ output to its target plugin subdirectory.

ag-core.description: Product-agnostic LLM/agentic tooling — memory, reflection, interviews, plan review/verify

ag-shared.description: Shared tooling across ag-charts/ag-grid/ag-studio — engineering, PM, release, prompt/rulesync

ag-charts.description: AG Charts product-specific — chart docs, series performance, visual QA

notes.localItems: The following items currently in .rulesync/ (local tier) stay local and are NOT in any plugin: skills[technology-stack]. These appear alongside plugin skills as bare /name (no namespace conflict because plugin items use /ag-*:name).
notes.directCommits: The 6 agents in ag-charts (data-viz-designer, example-tester, previs-evaluator, technical-research-analyst, test-writer, visual-qa) and all ag-charts skills/commands are direct commits to ag-dev-prompts — they must be placed in plugins/ag-charts/ when committed.
notes.excludedFromPlugin: hooks/, .mcp.json, .claude-settings.json, .cursor-worktrees.json are excluded (conflict with project settings when loaded as plugin).
notes.beta: Version 0.5.0-beta.4 promotes the cross-product release skills (releases, release-summary) out of the ag-charts .rulesync/ local tier into ag-shared. release-summary was previously a /release-summary command; it is now a skill because auto-triggering on release-branch discussion is more useful than an explicit invocation. 0.5.0-beta.3 migrated chart-tooling guides and release-triage skills. 0.5.0-beta.2 added the first wave of wrapper guides. 0.5.0-beta.1 collapsed six plugins to three. Beta tag is retained until every downstream repo has migrated.
